notes: Fixes multi-cover loading in The Library. The multiple-wrap splitter now uses the same existing Load-ImageUnlocked path as the working single-cover splitter instead of a separate image loader. It also replaces the previous v1.0.7 inline batch code cleanly so only one batch system remains. If any selected file still fails to open, the app now reports the specific filename/error instead of silently collapsing everything into a generic message. The batch editor remains inside the Split tab, keeps per-cover Title/Book, Ship, Fandom, Extra Tags, Cover Type and spine guides, and each cover can still be saved individually to The Library. Windows PowerShell parsing, synthetic v1.0.7-to-v1.0.8 patching, payload validation, and all internal SHA-256 checks passed before publish.
